text: Turn stageview content into ready-to-play LED output.
On the Mapping page you build your input-to-output mapping.
Set your stageview resolution, and add one or more output screens.
Each slice takes a region of the input and places it on the output.
Every slice supports rotation, flip, and input masks.
Import your Resolume XML directly, or export it back out.
The Output Map shows how your content lands on each screen.
On the Export page, add your footage — images or video.
You instantly see it on the input map, with slices and masks.
Adjust fit, scale, rotation and colour, live, per clip.
Trim with in and out points and an audio waveform.
Pick your codec — DXV3, HAP, ProRes or HEVC.
Set alpha, bit depth and GPU, or match the source in one click.
Check the output, choose a folder, and start the export.
Play it on any device. Free and open source — download it on GitHub.
